name: comp-183
blurb: Switch with moon/sun icons inside, sliding over two states.
description: Theme toggle with moon and sun icons displayed in the switch track, with smooth sliding animation.
use_when: Compact theme switching in headers where both states are visible simultaneously.
avoid_when: When icons need more breathing room or when larger touch targets are required.
a11y: Built on accessible Switch primitive with sr-only text label and aria-hidden decorative icons.
